text_block_list.text:
In the midst of the Satsuki Sho, Admire 
Vega roared. Burning brightly with the 
desire to "defeat my rival." Though the 
victory was ultimately surrendered—

That burning passion lingered even after 
returning to the academy. Watching Narita 
Top Road train toward her next 
battleground, the Japan Derby—

Admire Vega had finally voiced her 
anticipation for the next race.

Without a doubt, the feeling of "enjoying 
racing alongside a rival" was beginning to 
sprout within her.

However—in stark contrast to such joyful 
changes, the sky remained shrouded in 
heavy clouds for a long time.

With the foreshadowing of monumental 
changes in the air, the days leading up to 
the Japan Derby began.
